reasoning: Finale of Devastation is the deck's tutor-to-battlefield engine; with 7 mana it can fetch a stabilizing creature (e.g. Kogla/Thorn Mammoth) to block the flying Angels, advancing the board better than holding Heroic Intervention on an empty token board.
